name: AI agent cost overrun answer card
primary_buyer_question: What should we check before increasing AI agent, chatbot, workflow, token or tool budgets?
safe_answer: Start with a no-credentials owner evidence review: identify the workflow trigger, split fixed vs variable costs, sample retry loops, define human pause gates, preserve quality evidence, compare tool-neutral options and set a weekly owner decision loop before scaling or switching vendors.
claim_boundaries: No customer data or credentials required for first review
No savings, ROI, ranking, uptime, vendor approval or AI accuracy guarantee
No legal, compliance, procurement, security certification, financial or tax advice
Synthetic buyer-education asset; not a client case study or production log
